facts.recommendationText: Map the cash-conversion cycle and build a receivables segmentation and collections plan Locate where cash is trapped in receivables/payables before any financing or factoring Cash-conversion-cycle mapping and a collections plan are low-cost and reversible; they avoid factoring all receivables at punitive rates before the cycle is understood. Cash is trapped in working capital; the conversion cycle must be mapped before any financing decision Quantify DSO, DPO, and inventory days into a cash-conversion-cycle map by customer/supplier segment. Cash-conversion cycle mapped with the largest receivables drivers identified Segment receivables and stand up a prioritized collections plan for the slowest-paying accounts. Collections plan live for the top overdue receivables
